title: Ders Yok Günleri
author: Övgü Tahberer Terleç
description: Like almost all children, school and lessons were very boring for Can and his friends. They wanted to play phone games and spend a lot of time on social media. That morning, something unexpected happened: the Minister of Education announced that there would be no more lessons in schools! It must have been a dream! For a while, everything was a lot of fun, but then things got complicated. School, exams, achievements, even life itself had turned into a game. All values began to be forgotten in the shadow of social media accounts. And right at that point, the children ruined the game again!
